headings.usage: Hero title, large price predictions, form section titles

body.usage: Form labels, general UI text, select dropdowns

data_and_numbers.usage: Dates, times, predicted price output, input values

background.gradient: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.1), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1), transparent 40%)

layouts.page_structure: Asymmetrical split. Do NOT use a centered card. Left side (60% width on desktop): 3D Interactive Background (Globe.gl). Right side (40% width on desktop): Floating Glassmorphism Form container aligned vertically center. On mobile: stack them with 3D fixed in background, form scrolling over.
layouts.form_grid:
Use a Bento-style CSS Grid inside the form. 'display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;'.
Row 1: Airline (span 2).
Row 2: Source (span 1), Destination (span 1).
Row 3: Journey Date (span 1), Total Stops (span 1).
Row 4: Departure Time (span 1), Arrival Time (span 1).
Row 5: Predict Button (span 2).
Row 6: Result Box (span 2).
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Form padding: 40px (p-10). Input padding: 16px. Border radius for form: 24px. Border radius for inputs: 12px.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Form container MUST have 'backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%);' and 'border: 1px solid var(--glassBorder);'. Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glowing_accents: Inputs on :focus must have 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00F0FF, 0 0 12px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);' and 'border-color: #00F0FF'.
visual_enhancers.button_styling: Predict button must have a linear gradient background (from #7C5CFF to #00F0FF) and a strong hover glow: 'box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4)'.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All inputs use 'transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;'. Button hover uses 'transform: translateY(-2px);' and 'filter: brightness(1.1);'.

3d_libraries.integration: Include `<script src="//unpkg.com/globe.gl"></script>` in HTML. Mount it to a `#globe-container` positioned absolute/fixed covering the screen (z-index: -1).
3d_libraries.styling: Configure Globe.gl: `globeImageUrl('//unpkg.com/three-globe/example/img/earth-dark.jpg')`, `backgroundColor('rgba(0,0,0,0)')`. Optional: add some simulated arcs (flight paths) across the globe to match the flight prediction theme.

background_fallback.description: Dark purple geometric tech background (Use as a CSS background if WebGL fails to load or behind the globe for depth).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are updating a Flask application. Modify the HTML/CSS/JS templates, keeping Flask backend routing strictly intact.
Do NOT introduce React, Vue, or Shadcn. Stick to pure HTML, vanilla CSS (with CSS variables), and vanilla JavaScript.
The UI MUST NOT be a basic centered card. Execute the asymmetrical layout specified in the layouts section.
Add Globe.gl via CDN to the JS file/HTML to render the 3D globe. Place the canvas in a fixed container.
Implement the 'Crystal Glass' glassmorphism for the prediction form (blur, translucent background, subtle border).
Inputs must be styled natively. Override default browser `<select>` and `<input type='date'>` styles. Add 'color-scheme: dark;' to the root so browser-native UI components match the dark theme.
Make the prediction result box pop with a distinct glowing border, styled with JetBrains Mono font when a prediction price is returned.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all inputs, select elements, the submit button, and the result display element.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA. Text on glass must be white or light gray.
All inputs must have visible `<label>` tags.
Focus states must be highly visible (neon glow).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts. Create depth with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like box-shadow, border-color, transform.
Include hover states and micro-animations on interactive elements.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use SVGs or a lightweight icon library if necessary.
Include 'data-testid' attributes for robust automated testing.
